verdict.rationale: Edge0 ships its own Python API: transformers-style AutoModel/AutoConfig/AutoEngine, with AutoEngine.from_pretrained loading a model in-process. That lets a developer call the runtime from Python. There is no evidence of a JavaScript or other-language library, or of an official client SDK for the HTTP server. The OpenAI-compatible endpoint only lets third-party clients connect, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: official JavaScript/other-language client libraries, a dedicated client SDK for the served endpoint, in-depth API reference docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call the runtime from official client libraries in languages like Python or JavaScript

citations.quote: transformers-style usage: `AutoModel` / `AutoConfig` / `AutoEngine` resolve the tier from the model name
